definitions.explanation: Employment status where someone works less than full-time or on a temporary basis, without being a permanent staff member. Often used for lecturers, public employees, and similar positions.

examples.japanese: {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{講師|こうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a part-time lecturer.

examples.japanese: {非常勤|ひじょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Part-time staff now receive bonuses too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{非常勤|ひじょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧かけもち⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I hold three part-time positions at different universities.

notes:
CONTRAST WITH {常勤|じょうきん}:
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}: part-time, non-permanent
- ⟦{常勤|じょうきん}→常勤：16063_joukin⟧: full-time, permanent

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{講師|こうし}: part-time lecturer
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{職員|しょくいん}: part-time staff
- {非常勤|ひじょうきん}{役員|やくいん}: non-standing director

USAGE:
Primarily used in institutional and official contexts (universities, government offices). For general part-time work, ⟦パートタイム→パートタイム：25267_paatotaimu⟧ or ⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧ is more common in everyday speech.
